title: Planning a Renewable Energy Presentation
sourceNotes: Naskah dan audio orisinal tim Success IELTS (disintesis lewat text-to-speech), tidak diambil dari buku atau tes resmi manapun. Lihat docs/DECISIONS.md untuk catatan soal sumber audio.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Come in. So, how is the preparation going for your presentation on renewable energy?

script.speaker: Student
script.text: It's going well, thank you. We've decided to focus on three types of energy: solar, wind, and hydro power.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: That sounds like a good range. Who in your group is working on which topic?

script.speaker: Student
script.text: I'm covering solar power myself. My teammate Daniel is researching wind energy, and Priya is looking at hydro power.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Good. And how long is each person's section expected to be?

script.speaker: Student
script.text: We're planning about five minutes each, so fifteen minutes in total, plus five minutes for questions at the end.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: That's a sensible structure. Have you decided on your main source for the solar power section?

script.speaker: Student
script.text: Yes, I'm using a report from the International Energy Agency published last year.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Excellent choice, that's a reliable source. One suggestion — try to include at least one real example, like a country that uses a lot of solar power.

script.speaker: Student
script.text: That's a great idea. I was thinking of using Germany as an example.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Perfect. When is the presentation due?

script.speaker: Student
script.text: It's on the fifteenth of next month, in the afternoon session.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Alright, make sure to send me your slides at least three days before, so I can give feedback.

script.speaker: Student
script.text: Of course, I'll send them by the twelfth then.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Sounds good. Good luck with the rest of the preparation.

questions.explanation: Mahasiswi berkata "Daniel is researching wind energy, and Priya is looking at hydro power."

prompt.text: Match Priya with the topic she is researching.

questions.explanation: Priya meneliti "hydro power" sesuai yang disebutkan mahasiswi.

prompt.text: What is the total length of the presentation, including the question session?

questions.explanation: Lima belas menit presentasi ditambah lima menit sesi tanya-jawab sama dengan dua puluh menit total.

prompt.text: Example country for the solar power section: ____

questions.explanation: Mahasiswi berkata dia berencana menggunakan Jerman ("Germany") sebagai contoh negara.

prompt.text: By what date will the student send her slides to the tutor?
prompt.instructions: Jawab dengan tanggal yang disebutkan dalam rekaman.

questions.explanation: Mahasiswi berkata "I'll send them by the twelfth then."
